title: A Glimpse of Hope
content:
Siddu remained silent for a moment after finishing his coffee.

A distant smile appeared on his face, as though another memory had slowly resurfaced.

"It happened about three months later," he said quietly. "I still remember that day... I think it was a Tuesday."

Sneha listened carefully.

"Like every other day, I reached college and sat in my classroom."

"The lecturer walked in, carrying a pile of notes. Without wasting a second, he began filling the entire blackboard with formulas and explanations. His only goal seemed to be making sure none of us had a chance to fall asleep."

A faint smile crossed Siddu's face.

"As usual, a couple of students still managed to doze off."

"The lecturer caught them immediately, scolded them in front of everyone, and sent them outside before continuing the class."

"Finally, the bell rang."

"The short break had begun."

Siddu paused for a moment before continuing.

"I was sitting quietly at my desk when, all of a sudden, my friend Adithya came running into the classroom. He looked completely out of breath, as though he had sprinted across the entire campus."

Before Siddu could even ask what had happened, Adithya grabbed his shoulder and said,

"Siddu... Shreya is here!"

Sneha instinctively leaned forward.

"I froze."

"I couldn't believe what I had just heard."

"'What did you say?' I asked."

"I saw her near the reception while I was going to fill my water bottle. She was walking toward the other section."

"For the first time in three long months, hope found its way back into my heart. It felt as though someone had breathed life back into me after months of darkness."

"My heartbeat became so loud that I could barely hear anything else."

"Without thinking, I immediately stood up."

"I just wanted to see her."

"I didn't care about anything else."

"But before I could even take a step toward the classroom door..."

Siddu sighed.

"Our in-charge, Satish sir, walked into the class."

His smile disappeared.

"He looked around the classroom and loudly announced,"

"Break is over! Everyone, sit in your places."

Most of the students quietly returned to their seats.

"But I couldn't."

"Not after waiting three long months."

"I hurried toward the door."

"As I was about to leave, Satish sir caught hold of my hand."

"Where do you think you're going?"

"I folded my hands and pleaded."

"Sir... I have something very important to do. Please... just give me two minutes."

"But he refused."

"No. Go back to your seat."

"I tried to explain again."

"Please, sir. It's really important."

"Instead of listening, he placed his hand on my shoulder and firmly pushed me back toward my seat."

Siddu's expression grew serious.

"I don't know what happened to me in that moment."

"Three months of pain..."

"Three months of waiting..."

"Three months of unanswered questions..."

"Everything exploded at once."

"I lost control."

I raised my voice and shouted,

"Sir! Why are you pushing me? I told you I have something important to do!"

The entire classroom fell silent.

No one had ever seen me speak to a teacher like that before.

Satish sir's face darkened with anger.

Without saying another word, he grabbed my wrist firmly.

"Come with me."

"I knew exactly where he was taking me."

"The principal's office."

Siddu looked at Sneha.

"But at that moment..."

He gave a helpless smile.

"At that moment, I wasn't afraid of the punishment... I wasn't afraid of the principal... I wasn't afraid of anything."

"I was afraid of only one thing..."

"What if Shreya disappeared once again before I got the chance to see her?"
